title: Take away their most efficient high-volume actions
supporting_stats: Offensive Rebound: 78.7% on 47 attempts; Cut: 68.4% on 193 attempts
recommendation: Each is 5+ points above their 47.9% overall clip on 15+ attempts. Offensive Rebound: hit a body on every shot before going to the ball. Cut: jump to the ball on every pass and see man and ball -- no back-cuts behind ball-watchers.

title: Funnel them into their worst high-volume looks
supporting_stats: P&R Ball Handler: 37.1% on 89 attempts; Off Screen: 37.8% on 230 attempts
recommendation: Each is 5+ points below their 47.9% overall clip -- don't help off these actions; make them keep taking them.

title: Pressure the actions they turn it over on
supporting_stats: P&R Ball Handler: 24 TO in 113 uses (21.2% vs 9.6% across all actions); Hand Off: 14 TO in 87 uses (16.1% vs 9.6% across all actions)
recommendation: Loosest actions per use, not the most common ones -- load ball pressure and gap help onto these specifically rather than pressing everything.
